SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listenin g and Speakin g 13.1.1 Pronunciation and: Intensive Listening, part of MONEY - TRADE Suggested Vocabulary currency, funds, stock, purchase, foreign exc in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade six ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why should we listen carefully? 2) Why do we use expression s such similes proverb and phrases?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify specific sounds, words, phrases, and sentences from a text,

C. use expressions such as similes, proverbs, fixed phrases, idioms and metaphors in oral contexts correctly,

   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

prepositions.
